item.title: In the 1830s, Americans bought tomato ketchup as medicine after a physician claimed tomatoes could treat indigestion and diarrhoea; pills made from tomato extract were sold across the country before the craze collapsed.
item.description: In the 1830s, Dr John Cook Bennett suggested that tomatoes had medicinal properties for treating digestive issues. This led to the creation of tomato extract pills sold as medicine by various entrepreneurs. The competition between manufacturers Archibald Miles and Dr Guy R. Phelps became known as the Tomato Pill War. Their public dispute was widely reported in newspapers and attracted significant attention. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Naturalists divided over potential impact of proposals to increase number of wild raptors in England and Wales White-tailed eagles reintroduced into England and Wales imperil endangered seabird populations and risk wiping out some colonies, ecologists and conservationists are warning. Puffins, guillemots, razorbills, fulmars and kittiwakes are among the birds for which breeding populations could collapse if large numbers of white-tailed eagles are released, according to some academics and conservationists. item.title: Goldie Hawn's MindUP helps 7 million children manage stress across 48 countries
item.description: Goldie Hawn established the Goldie Hawn Foundation in 2003 to support emotional awareness among children. MindUP, developed in collaboration with experts, integrates neuroscience and mindfulness into education. The program has reached over 7 million children across 48 countries since its inception. Lessons focus on emotional regulation, empathy, and stress management for children aged 3 to 14. With resources available online, families and educators can promote emotional development alongside academic learning. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Informe desde Antigua: muere el diputado Julio César Portillo tras tiroteo en Guatemala
item.description: El diputado guatemalteco Julio César Portillo murió tras un ataque armado en Zacapa, que también dejó tres agentes de la Policía fallecidos. El atentado ocurrió cuando hombres armados abrieron fuego contra la camioneta en la que se movilizaba el parlamentario. Este crimen ocurre tres semanas después del asesinato del exfiscal Juan Francisco Solórzano, una figura anticorrupción. El hecho ha generado conmoción en Guatemala y reavivado las preocupaciones sobre la seguridad y la violencia en el país en la antesala de su año electoral. El informe es de nuestro corresponsal Andrés Suárez Jaramillo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
